h1: Custom Flying Discs for Events & Promotions
metaDescription: Order custom flying discs for your next event. Perfect for trade shows, picnics, and giveaways. Low minimums, fast turnaround.
introHtml:
Planning a company picnic, a community festival, or a summer trade show? Custom flying discs are a classic giveaway that gets used again and again. Marketing directors love their low cost per impression, while HR directors find them ideal for employee appreciation events. Whether you need a 9" Flyer for a golf tournament or a 5" Mini Flyer for a conference swag bag, our selection fits any budget and audience.

Perfect Imprints offers flying discs in multiple sizes and colors, all customizable with your logo or message. Choose from standard frisbees, confetti flyers, or even branded yo-yos and kick balls for outdoor fun. With no minimum order quantity on many items, small businesses can order just enough for a team outing, while larger runs keep per-unit costs low for big events. Let’s get your brand flying high.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom flying discs, focus on three things: size, material, and decoration. Standard discs range from 5 inches (mini) to 9 inches (full-size). Mini discs work well as desk toys or bag stuffers, while full-size discs are better for active play. Most discs are made from durable polyethylene, which withstands rough handling and UV exposure. For a premium feel, look for discs with a glossy finish or custom color matching.

Use Cases and Buyer Personas

Marketing directors often use promotional flying discs at outdoor events like concerts, fairs, and sports tournaments. They’re also popular for beach giveaways and college orientations. HR directors might order branded flying discs for company picnics or wellness challenges. Safety managers can use them as incentives for safety program participation. Business owners appreciate that a single order can serve multiple purposes—from customer thank-you gifts to trade show handouts.

Decoration Options

Screen printing is the most common method for custom flying discs, offering vibrant colors and good durability at a low cost. For full-color logos or gradients, consider heat transfer or sublimation, which bonds the design into the plastic. Pad printing works well for small runs or detailed artwork on mini discs. Always request a proof before production to ensure colors and placement are correct.

Quantity and MOQ Considerations

Bulk custom flying discs orders typically start at 50 to 100 pieces, but many items have no minimum. Wholesale pricing kicks in around 250 units, making larger events more cost-effective. If you need a small batch for a team or department, look for no-minimum items like the 5" Mini Flyer. For large-scale giveaways, ordering 500 or more can reduce per-unit costs significantly.

Common Buying Mistakes

One common mistake is choosing a disc that’s too small for your intended use—mini discs can’t be thrown far and may disappoint at active events. Another is overlooking the artwork size limit: discs have a curved surface, so large logos may warp. Always check the printable area. Also, consider lead time: screen printing takes longer than pad printing, so plan accordingly. Finally, order samples if you’re unsure about color or quality.

faqs.q: What sizes are available for custom flying discs?
faqs.a: We offer mini discs (5 inches), standard discs (9 inches), and specialty sizes like the 7" Saturn Flying Disk. Mini discs are great for desk toys or bag stuffers, while full-size discs are ideal for outdoor activities.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom flying discs?
faqs.a: Many flying discs have no minimum order quantity, so you can order as few as one. For screen-printed discs, typical MOQs start at 50 to 100 units. Check individual product pages for specific requirements.

faqs.q: How are flying discs decorated with my logo?
faqs.a: The most common method is screen printing, which works well for solid colors. For full-color designs, we use heat transfer or sublimation. Pad printing is available for small items like mini discs.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we recommend ordering a sample of the blank disc to check size, weight, and feel. For custom-printed samples, a setup fee may apply. Contact our sales team for details.

faqs.q: How long does production take for custom flying discs?
faqs.a: Standard production time is 7–10 business days after artwork approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Shipping time depends on your location and chosen method.
